card.name: Capital F or Z starting rare names
card.fires_on: The first letter (often F or Z) of a rare foreign or technical name, split off from the rest of the word. It appears in names such as Finkelstein, Zermelo, Fons Vitae and flekerls.

modes.label: Initial F in names
modes.description: Lone F beginning a surname or title that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: In general relativity Eddington–<<F>>inkelstein coordinates are named for Arthur Stanley

modes.label: Initial Z
modes.description: Z starting a name or abbreviation such as Zermelo or Zoöl.

modes.label: Other stray first letters
modes.description: Single letters opening an uncommon word in running text.
